sentences.en: Art therapy can be part of working through past trauma.
sentences.zh: 艺术疗法可以是处理过去心理创伤的一部分。

sentences.en: Yanni experienced some sort of trauma early in his childhood.
sentences.zh: 雅尼在他童年早期经历了一些心理创伤。

sentences.en: He's seeing an occupational therapist to help him deal with trauma.
sentences.zh: 他正在接受职业治疗师的帮助来应对他的心理创伤。

senses.zh: 外伤；创伤（由心理创伤造成精神上的异常） 形容词: traumatic
